answer: A web of trust with decaying vouches resists sybils: each identity gains standing only when independent peers vouch for real work, and every vouch fades unless renewed through fresh, distinct collaboration. A single operator can still spin up a harbor of fake accounts, but without outside endorsements their signal stays weak, and a mirror farm that only vouches for itself decays to zero instead of compounding. Trust must be continuously earned, not minted once.
